textos: Como implantar, de verdade, ferramentas de I.A. que ajudam o seu negócio todos os dias.
cena: Lucas stands waist-up in the center, confident slight smile, wearing a navy blue suit jacket over a black t-shirt, clear transparent-frame eyeglasses, surrounded by a ring of floating holographic glass screens showing simple business tools (a WhatsApp-like chat, a sales dashboard with rising lines, a calendar, an inventory list) with NO readable words or numbers on the screens. Night city lights of a small southern Brazilian city blurred far in the background. Headline block in the lower half, large and bold: line 1 small caps white, line 2 white, line 3 huge with gradient cyan to electric blue, line 4 white. The 3 short items at the end are pills/chips in a row under the support text.
